run_time_func_benchmark: run time_func to benchmark a callable over 100 iterations with warmup and print average ms
test_time_func_custom_iterations: test time_func with a custom number of iterations to measure performance of a function
test_time_func_named: test time_func with a custom name label to identify the benchmarked function in output
refactor_time_func_for_return: refactor time_func to return the measured time in ms instead of only printing it
summarize_time_func: summarize the time_func utility that warms up then times a callable over N iterations
